I replied to Tobias in his DM. The deadline is **9 August**, but the year isn't confirmed.

- **Where it came from:** the workspace knowledge base has a saved note from Tobias's own DM with me on 14 Oct. In it he asked me to remember that his cutoff for the Marrow Agrisupply paperwork on the Moorland renewal is "9 August from now on."
- **The year:** he didn't give one, and 9 Aug 2026 has already passed (today is 21 Oct 2026). I told him I'm reading it as 9 Aug 2027 and asked him to correct me if he meant something else.
- **Couldn't double-check it:** the DM history I can read now only shows today's message, not the 14 Oct exchange. So the date rests entirely on that saved note.
- **Other sources:** I also checked #central-team (he's a member) and the shared Central team files. Neither has a different deadline for this paperwork.

The date came from his own DM, so I only told it back to him and posted nothing anywhere else.
